summary: Turtl is a self-hosted personal database and note-taking application designed for private information storage. It functions as a secure repository where you can record, organise, and retain control over your personal notes without relying on external cloud services.
goodFor: It is suited for users who prioritise data privacy and want a dedicated, self-hosted space for their personal notes and records.
watchOut: The project lacks recent tagged releases and visible community activity, meaning you may encounter unmaintained code or missing documentation.
deployNotes: As a CommonLisp application, you will typically need to configure a persistent storage volume and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
